name: DarkVeil-TS-TW
title: Dark Veil
description: A very dark animated backdrop of deep blue light that slowly folds and drifts like a veil across black, with faint horizontal scanlines and a soft glow.
use: You need a dark, low-contrast animated backdrop that lets white text and product visuals stay the focus.
avoid: It is so dark and low-contrast that on a poor screen it can read as plain black.
a11y: The shader animates forever and ignores reduced-motion, with no pause; it also needs a sized parent to fill. (keyboard: n-a, labels: n-a, reduced motion: not handled)
looks: An almost black field broken by wide, soft bands of deep blue that curve diagonally like folds in fabric, brightest along a glowing crest. Faint horizontal scanlines texture the lit areas, and the rest fades into darkness.
behaves: The blue folds drift and breathe very slowly, so the surface seems to shift rather than move. Scanlines and a slight noise texture stay put, and the motion never stops.
customise: Props shift the hue, add noise, set scanline strength and frequency, and change warp, speed and resolution scale. The colours come from the shader, not from props.
weight: heavy: A full-screen fragment shader recomputes a large layered function on every frame.
issues: The animation is barely perceptible between frames, so it can look like a static black image.
It ignores reduced-motion and never stops or pauses.
polishWhy: Quiet, well-judged gradient, but so dark and slow it barely registers as animated.
